information:
#### This competition only has blindfolded events and fewest moves, not the more popular speedsolving events. You can find other NZ competitions [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=NZ). 

Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. Live results for this competition can be found on [WCA Live](https://live.worldcubeassociation.org/).
